summary: A top Soldier fills all 13 implant slots with ARTILLERY-Unit symbiants - the ranged-weapon unit. The Artillery line is profession-locked to Soldier, Fixer, Agent, Adventurer and Trader (ToWear stat-60 EqualTo {1,4,5,6,7}, verified in items.ocp; 293 of the 305 Artillery templates a Soldier can wear carry that lock). Summed over the complete 13-slot Xan Artillery ALPHA set, read from items.ocp, the line gives +289 to EVERY ranged weapon skill a Soldier uses (Assault Rifle, Shotgun, MG/SMG, Ranged Energy, Heavy Weapons, Pistol, Rifle, Grenade, Sharp Object, Multi Ranged), +289 to every ranged special (Burst, Full Auto, Fling Shot, Aimed Shot), +289 Ranged Init, +289 Evade Close / Dodge Ranged / Duck Exp, +1149 Max Health and +180 Add. All Def. That is the whole Soldier stat sheet in one line, which is why symbiants beat cluster implants for this profession outright. Best-in-slot at endgame is the Xan Artillery-Unit ALPHA in every slot; the Xan Artillery BETA is the lower-requirement stepping stone (Treatment 1870 / level 201 against 2088 / 219). WHERE TO GET THEM: the Artillery ladder is Shadowlands pocket-boss loot (summon the boss at an Incarnator from a crafted Novictalized Notum Crystal) up to QL280; the QL300 'Intelligent ... Artillery Unit Aban' for every slot comes from The Night Heart on Pandemonium Antenora; the Xan Betas come from the three Legacy-of-the-Xan Central Hub encounters except Ear and Thigh, which are quest rewards; the Alphas are crafted, never looted. See farmingRuns for the location-by-location plan and acquisitionBySlot for the per-slot ladder.

unitChoice.why: Artillery is the ranged-weapon unit. Verified from the client data, not from memory: every Artillery symbiant's ToWear action profession-locks to stat 60 EqualTo {1 Soldier, 4 Fixer, 5 Agent, 6 Adventurer, 7 Trader} (items.ocp), and the extractor run with --prof 1 returns 293 Artillery templates against 0 from Control / Extermination / Infantry / Support.
unitChoice.note: Unlike the Meta-Physicist, which can wear Control, Extermination and Support and therefore has a real unit CHOICE, the Soldier has none: Artillery is the only unit line whose ToWear lock includes profession 1. The only non-Artillery symbiants a Soldier can wear are the client-data templates that carry no profession lock at all plus the Soldier-only Syndicate piece - see outsideLineSymbiants.

alphaCrafting.what: Xan Alpha symbiants are the most advanced symbiants in AO. They cannot be looted - each is crafted by the player from two QL300 components, is NODROP (items.ocp Flags bit 26) and cannot be reverted once assembled.
alphaCrafting.recipe: Combine (drag + shift-click, or the tradeskill window) a Xan <slot> Symbiant, Artillery Unit Beta with an Intelligent <slot> Symbiant, Artillery Unit Aban QL300 of the SAME slot and SAME unit line. No tradeskill tool or nano is required.

xanBeta.what: Xan Artillery-Unit Beta for the slot, QL300, Treatment 1870 / level 201 to wear.

components.intelligentQL300: Intelligent Artillery-Unit (Aban) QL300 for the slot - the top-QL Shadowlands symbiant. For all 13 Artillery slots the only recorded source is The Night Heart on Pandemonium Antenora (level-250 static raid boss, NOT a pocket boss - it cannot be summoned at an Incarnator). Tradeable (no NoDrop bit in items.ocp), so it can also be bought.

equipRequirements.note: Requirements to WEAR the finished Artillery Alpha, read from items.ocp ToWear. Identical across all 13 slots except the one variable ability.
equipRequirements.fixedAbilities: Artillery's two fixed abilities are Agility and Strength, each 1276. The Meta-Physicist's Control line uses Intelligence + Psychic instead - this is the concrete place the Soldier twink target differs.
equipRequirements.variableAbilityBySlot: The third equip ability varies by slot (Intelligence, Sense, Stamina or Strength), each 1276 - see each bestInSlot row's reqs.

alphaCrafting.clickyTrick: Xan Beta Ear and Thigh are the quest rewards and the only two that are clickable: right-click cycles their unit type through all five lines. The other eleven Betas are NOT clickable - their unit is fixed on drop. Money-saver: buy the cheapest Intelligent Ear/Thigh of any unit, cycle the Beta to match, combine, then cycle the resulting Alpha back to Artillery.
alphaCrafting.upgradeOverBase: Per slot the Alpha beats both components. Brain example, all three figures read from items.ocp: the Beta gives Ranged Energy / Bow Spc Att / Treatment / Comp. Lit. +130 and Ranged Init +79; the Intelligent QL300 gives +137 / +83; the Alpha gives +144 / +87 and adds Psychology, Map Navigation and the three Vehicle skills.

xanAlphaNote: Endgame path for a Soldier: Shadowlands Artillery symbiants (top tier 'Intelligent', QL300, from The Night Heart) are the base; the Legacy-of-the-Xan 'Xan ... Artillery Unit Beta' symbiants are a lower-requirement stepping stone at Treatment 1870 / level 201; the crafted 'Xan ... Artillery Unit Alpha' (Beta + Intelligent QL300) is best-in-slot at Treatment 2088 / level 219. The Alphas and the Ear/Thigh Betas are NODROP - build the Alpha on the Soldier that will wear it.

The Meta-Physicist's caster key set silently dropped Assault Rifle, Shotgun, MG/SMG, Ranged Energy, Heavy Weapons, Burst, Full Auto, Fling Shot, Aimed Shot and Ranged Init from every Artillery row - that is, the entire point of the line.

_verification.farmLocations: Acquisition is joined onto every item by AO item id from (1) the TinkerTools/TinkerPocket community drop database via its public API and (2) hand-curated, guide-cited entries in tools/mp-symbiant-extractor/farm-sources-manual.json. _verification.noDropFlags: NODROP/Unique are read from items.ocp Stats entry 0 (Flags), bit 26 = NoDrop, bit 27 = Unique (OmniCell.Enums/ItemFlags.cs) - not from a website. All 13 Artillery Alphas are NODROP; the Ear and Thigh Betas (the quest rewards) are NODROP; every other Beta and the whole Aban line are tradeable.
_verification.setTotals: The per-skill set totals in `summary` and unitChoice.setTotalsAcrossAll13XanAlphas are SUMMED by the generator from the 13 Alpha rows' own bonus tables in items.ocp, not quoted from a guide.
